$comment: opencv4 is pinned to a headless feature set: frames are rendered by Qt Quick, so the gtk/highgui backends are excluded. They pull in the entire GTK stack (gtk3, at-spi2-core, dbus, libsystemd) for windows this application never opens. dnn and calib3d are load bearing rather than incidental: dnn runs every model in the CPU perception backend, and calib3d provides the similarity transform that aligns a face onto the ArcFace reference points. whisper-cpp and ggml stay for the desktop and web speech path, which the Pi replaces with Moonshine; see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-19-cpu-perception-backends.md.
